result.description: Compact ambient light projector for bedrooms, studios, and small event spaces. The WX-16 uses a low-power LED engine with a rotating prism module to cast slow-moving geometric patterns on walls and ceilings. It offers three scene modes, a silent cooling design, adjustable focus, and USB-C power input for portable indoor use.
